quest.title: Adventurer's Entrance Exam
quest.description: After fully understanding Noelle's reasons for seeking him out, an elated and excited Cyrus decides to put you both through his new exam at the highest difficulty level.

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Go for it, Noelle! Remember, keep track of your time!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle's Study Notes
dialogues.text: "Windwheel Asters commonly found at Stormterror's Lair and Windrise," "Hit Ruin Guards in weak spots to gain upper hand"...

dialogues.speaker: Noelle's Study Notes
dialogues.text: Each and every new detail learned during the adventure is recorded in neat and tidy handwriting — though it starts to get messier as you go down the page.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle's Study Notes
dialogues.text: Some vague descriptions are closely followed by precise annotations adding further detail. This seems to be evidence of the writer fighting a valiant battle against sleepiness.

talks.objective: Return to the library and find Noelle

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I should at least finish this book before taking a break...
